::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Lifecycle authority

The accepted numerical operations, physical component models, units, evidence
workspace, and Result meanings remain `STABILIZED`. Acceptance and
stabilization are not release claims.

The public authoring grammar, structured Plan identity, certified diagrams,
and independent Parameter System are reopened in documentation-first targets.
[CircuitPlan Assembly](circuit-plan-assembly.qmd) owns the common model;
[Automatic Semantic Circuit Diagram Layout](automatic-semantic-circuit-diagram-layout.qmd)
owns composition and visual evidence; [Parameter System, Sweeps, and Bound
Results](parameter-system.qmd) owns definitions, physical bindings, points,
spaces, sweep Results, and optimization binding. Both remain `CONVERGING`;
target runtime implementation is paused and the Tutorial examples are not
executable on the current runtime.
:::

The model-first [Tutorial](../index.qmd) and
[Concept](../concepts/physical-authority-and-reusable-composition.qmd) explain
the reader workflow before these exact contracts: author one complete Plan,
inspect its ASCDLS projection, then independently select `run.original` or a
derived View for a numerical request. Diagram rendering never selects or
mutates that analysis View.

## Public contracts

Read these when deciding what a Notebook user may declare, execute, inspect,
and resolve.

- [Component Authoring Contract](../component-authoring.qmd) retains catalogs,
  physical component fields and public boundaries, RLGC, Josephson/SQUID,
  mutual coupling, and Direct/HB lowering semantics.
- [CircuitPlan Assembly](circuit-plan-assembly.qmd) defines root/inline/reusable
  assembly, equivalent ordinary public pins, open boundaries, completeness,
  and shared Plan identity for independent consumers.
- [Automatic Semantic Circuit Diagram Layout](automatic-semantic-circuit-diagram-layout.qmd)
  defines handle-based layout including named-tap presentation order,
  independent audits, and code-free review.
- [Parameter System, Sweeps, and Bound Results](parameter-system.qmd) defines
  independent input identities, physical Plan adoption, immutable points and
  spaces, batch Result inspection, optimization binding, and parameterized
  diagrams.
- [V1 Runtime Contract](../v1-runtime-contract.qmd) defines Runs, Refs, Specs,
  units, reduction, Direct/HB behavior, optimization, Results, attempts,
  receipts, failure, and known limits.

Public contracts own product semantics. An implementation page may explain a
mechanism, dependency, data layout, or delivery slice, but it cannot weaken or
replace a public invariant.

## Implementation Design {#implementation-design}

Read this collection in order before changing the implementation. Each page
answers one maintainer question. Together they cover the full Tutorial and every
currently declared public V1 surface. Post-V1 surfaces remain fail-fast unless
a later Human-accepted scope implements them.

2. [When is a Plan sealed, and what is hashed?](../implementation/plan-sealing-and-identity.qmd)
3. [Which canonical bytes and schemas define identity?](../implementation/canonical-identities-and-schemas.qmd)
4. [How are catalog and runtime identities made portable?](../implementation/catalog-and-runtime-identity.qmd)
5. [How is Julia prepared without manual setup?](../implementation/julia-runtime-preparation.qmd)
6. [What crosses the Python–Julia process boundary?](../implementation/python-julia-protocol.qmd)
7. [How are requests, attempts, receipts, and arrays stored?](../implementation/workspace-attempts-and-artifacts.qmd)
8. [How is a Composite sealed and recursively expanded?](../implementation/composite-snapshots-and-recursive-expansion.qmd)
9. [How do primitive compilation and logical Ports form one physical graph?](../implementation/compilation-ports-and-views.qmd)
10. [How do Q2D matrices become a complete pi ladder?](../implementation/rlgc-q2d-and-pi-expansion.qmd)
11. [How does an ordered Ref lineage become one selected network?](../implementation/view-lineage-and-selected-networks.qmd)
12. [How is one loaded diagonal root solved and certified?](../implementation/diagonal-root-numerical-procedure.qmd)
13. [How are poles, zeros, response elements, couplings, and operators evaluated?](../implementation/direct-poles-zeros-and-operators.qmd)
14. [How are Direct operators and optimization evaluated efficiently?](../implementation/direct-quantities-and-optimization.qmd)
15. [How are full V1 HB normalization and case outcomes realized?](../implementation/hb-realization-and-outcomes.qmd)

17. [How are external inputs, provenance, and the four implementation slices bounded?](../implementation/external-inputs-and-delivery.qmd)

The collection remains the implementation authority for stabilized numerical
behavior. Pages that still describe flat-node or superseded diagram source are
explicitly frozen implementation baseline, not the structured TARGET API. The
target diagram mechanism and paused delivery boundary are summarized only in
[Results, reports, and diagrams](../implementation/results-reports-and-diagrams.qmd).
